annotations.title: Re-roll / restyle / resize an artifact's design

description: Redraw a flyer, page, t-shirt or brochure's design from its own content — apply a new Style, reshuffle the composition with a new seed, or resize it to another preset — WITHOUT touching a word of its copy or regenerating its image. Zero-generation and repeatable (packages/schema rebuilds it, never a model), the flyer analogue of reroll_deck. Omit styleId to redraw with the current Style; pass sizePreset to resize; pass seed to make the draw reproducible. A face/panel with no re-roll stamp is left exactly as it was and reported, never guessed.

seed.description: Reproducible draw; the same seed + Style gives the same result.

sizePreset.description: Flyer: resize to this preset (Letter | A4 | A5 | poster-tabloid | square | story).

styleId.description: A curated Style id from list_styles. Omit to keep the current Style.

zonePreset.description: T-shirt: re-zone to this print area (full-front | front-chest | left-chest | back | sleeve).

name: reroll_artifact
